source.section: Instructions PDF pp.9-10, Schedule M line 1t, questions 1 and 2 and table lines 1-4; Instructions PDF p.10, Schedule M line 1v; Guide PDF p.15; Instructions PDF p.4, RI-1040 lines 1-5; PDF p.5, lines 6-8; PDF p.13, Tax Computation Worksheet ('Use for all filing status types')

worked: Federal AGI = private pension (person 0) 60,000.00 + military pension (person 0) 40,000.00 + interest 30,000.00 = 130,000.00. Federal taxable income = 130,000.00 - 31,500.00 standard deduction - 2 x 1,600.00 age 65+ = 95,300.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). RI-1040 line 1 federal AGI 130,000.00. Line 1t: question 1 born on or before March 1, 1959: person 0 born 1955-06-15 (age 70), person 1 born 1956-06-15 (age 69): yes; question 2 federal AGI 130,000.00 less than or equal to 133,750.00: yes. Table: person 0 line 2 60,000.00, line 3 lesser of that and 50,000.00 = 50,000.00; person 1 line 2 0.00, line 3 lesser of that and 50,000.00 = 0.00; line 4 = 50,000.00. Line 1v military service pension 40,000.00 (in full, no age or income test). Line 1y total decreasing modifications = 90,000.00. Line 2a other-state obligations 0.00; line 2m total increasing modifications = 0.00. Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 0.00 - 90,000.00 = -90,000.00; RI-1040 line 2 = -90,000.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 130,000.00 + (-90,000.00) = 40,000.00. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: line 3 40,000.00 is not more than 254,250.00: the worksheets stop at line 3, full amounts. Line 4 standard deduction: 21,800.00 (Married filing jointly). Line 5 = 40,000.00 - 21,800.00 = 18,200.00. Line 6 exemptions: 2 x 5,100.00 = 10,200.00. Line 7 taxable income = 18,200.00 - 10,200.00 = 8,000.00. Line 8 tax on 8,000.00 by the schedule as numbers: 8,000.00 x 0.0375 = 300.000000 = 300.00. Credits 0.00 (Schedule I, Schedule II, RI earned income credit and RI-1040H are not modelled and not claimed here). Rhode Island income tax = 300.00. Note: The table on line 1t keeps military pay out of line 2, so the 50,000 stays whole: 50,000 + 40,000 = 90,000. The other reading of the Guide's 'less any amount claimed' (PDF p.9), a cap reduced to 10,000, would give 50,000 and is not what the form does (settlement).
